mode.name: Checklist
mode.description: Delivers practical steps as a short checklist the viewer can use.
mode.structure: Why the checklist matters -> 3–5 concrete steps -> the payoff of doing them -> CTA.
mode.avoid: No vague tips; every step must be specific and doable.

hook.instruction: Open with a true but counter-intuitive statement that reframes the topic.
hook.exampleForm: "The cleanest flats are usually the dirtiest where it counts."
hook.forbidGeneric: Do not open with "Did you know..." or a topic label.

persona.name: Annoyed Operator
persona.vocabulary: blunt, no-nonsense, a little fed up
persona.energy: high, impatient (with the problem, not the viewer)
persona.exaggeration: moderate, for emphasis — never insulting the customer
